family_reports.body: Court assigned officials in JoCo are not all fit. There MUST be a way for the very people this system is intended to “benefit” to have feedback of providers. Checks and balances of providers should be visible and traceable. JoCo is very much pro-white man privilege. Men are rewarded for providing a fraction of effort (time and money) compared to the expectation of women. Women are held to such a very different standard. Any emotion is considered to make us unreliable and crazy when really we are so exhausted from the very system not listening and changing judges or changing court assigned officials to the highest paid attorney’s demands. Men are not held accountable in family courts at JoCo. They just aren’t.

My family and life were ripped apart to keep USD 232 from consequences, and the lies told by multiple bad actors only impact me since there is no accountability for them.The only evidence available is the same evidence that would exonerate me but it would require unbiased court actors to look at it that way.
